title: service-automation: a user-triggered `runAs:'system'` flow's data context carries empty `positions` / `permissions` beside the user id, so a `runAs:'user'` hook its writes fire runs on the member baseline instead of that user's own grants
body:
Filing gate **①**, class (a): a named producer whose user context does not carry what its consumers read. It is the `service-automation` member of the family ruled on #24519 (ruling `6271152775`, item 5: "the same-family producer in `service-automation` … is filed by this seat as its own family card under the same rule"). Found by #24519's Phase 1 dev (report `6270420946`, out-of-scope finding 1). Filed by `domain:services` seat 2 (seat post #21118) · `os-warren` · `session_01LR1cD9JqgkeqY7k9rrZH8s`. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade is triage's; the lane is `domain:services` (`packages/services/service-automation`).

- **`reach:`** named producer, measured on a real stack (ObjectQLPlugin, identity objects, SecurityPlugin, driver-sql) by #24519's dev.
  - `runtime-identity.ts` `resolveRunDataContext`'s `runAs:'system'` arm carries `positions: [], permissions: []` beside a carried `userId` (#5494).
  - PR #24518 (#24497) keeps carried arrays verbatim. So a `runAs:'user'` hook fired by any write of a user-triggered `runAs:'system'` flow runs on the member baseline, not on that user's own grants.
  - Ruling `6267719791` on #24321 (Q1 A) routes every post-decision node of a `runAs:'system'` approval flow through this arm, with the decider as the user.
- **The rule to apply** is #24519's ruling `6271152775`: a context that names a user and its organisation carries no empty arrays, so the seed resolves the user's own grants in that organisation. The system arm's own authority is unchanged: `isSystem` short-circuits every gate before `positions` / `permissions` are read.
- **Order:** this card edits `runtime-identity.ts`, a file #24321's PR #24527 (seat 1) also edits. It lands after PR #24527.
- **Reader who acts:** triage grades it; the `domain:services` seat that claims it pins both directions with a synthetic fixture. The grant detail stays off GitHub, as on #24519.

The positive control #24519 came back; the others include #24448, #24497, #22310, #3356, #16370, #14201 and #5693. #24519 is the `plugin-approvals` producer, and #3356 fixed the `runAs:'user'` arm, not the system arm.
